character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Full-body young female Poison Rogue with a narrow curved silhouette, small flexible build, alert green eyes, dark hair tied close to the head and one shoulder forward. A fitted plum combat jacket (#68436f) dominates her torso and diagonal hip panels; charcoal-black trousers and quiet shoes keep the lower body narrow. Dark near-black leather (#463532) protects the forearms without becoming a brown visual mass. Acid green (#8aa63f) appears only in tiny droplet-shaped stitches at the cuffs and collar. Her face and hands remain visible. No beige clothes, green glow covering the body, hood, mask, dagger, vials or crossed carmine chest straps.
